title: Traffic Accident Report: How to Reporting to the Police in Dubai
description: Do not panic after a crash. Our guide covers everything you need to know about a traffic accident report in Dubai.

contentHtml:
Caught a road accident, don’t know what to do? Suddenly meeting a road accident when you are on a business trip or for any other travelling purposes can quickly become a stressful situation. Anyone who meets with an accident feels panicked and confused if there is substantial damage. The very first thing that pops into his mind is how to report the incident to the police.

Control of the situation is easy now if you know how to file a Dubai traffic accident report. This article is a perfect example of it. Learn the reporting process and who to contact in such a situation. The article entails details like:

  • The process to report an accident in Dubai
  • What to do after reporting an accident
  • IZI Rent a Car, your partner to comply with Dubai laws
  • Frequently asked questions related to a scenario

Step-by-Step Process To Report an Accident In Dubai

Meeting with an accident is an unfortunate period when you’re hopeless and get stressed easily. Knowing how to tackle the situation is all you need. Beforehand, do the needful, that is, the procedure to report an accident. So, you can imply it if it happens. Explore how to manage the scenario effectively. We are going to unwrap the step-by-step process. So that you don’t feel left out, and do what is required.

Evaluate the Situation

Stay calm and assess the damage if you get into a road accident. Move the car to the side of the road in case of minimal vehicle damage, and nobody is injured. Avoid blocking the road and traffic. If the vehicle damage is substantial or anyone is injured, it is better to leave the car where they are.

Call the Dubai Police

Notify the Dubai police immediately if it’s a minor or major accident. Call Dubai Police at 901 if the accident has resulted in serious damage. Request an ambulance if necessary or if someone faces injury. On calling, the Dubai Police will send the traffic police to the accident site.

Additionally, if there are no injuries or damages, file a car traffic accident report. You can report through Dubai online or via the Dubai Police mobile app.

Online Accident Report with the Dubai Police

Follow the steps to file a Dubai traffic accident report via the website or app. First, select the report traffic accident service. Secondly, fill out the application form. Then, attach photos of the damage. Lastly, submit a request on the portal.

Report an Accident in Dubai via ENOC

In collaboration with Emirates National Oil Company (ENOC), Dubai Police has launched the ‘On-The-Go’ initiative. The platform allows individuals in the emirate to report minor traffic accidents at ENOC service stations. File a report at the following stations.

  • Al Rasheed Street, Al Mizher
  • Al Khail Road
  • Al Khail Road
  • Arabian Ranches

Gather the Dubai Police Traffic Accident Report

Now, the time is to collect the report from the Dubai Police. Do not take it for granted; it’s important to do. Carrying out repairs without reporting a car accident in Dubai is illegal. The insurance companies will cover the repair cost only when the report is issued.

Important Note:

When Dubai Police are called to the accident scene, they will determine whose fault it is. They provide the drivers with either of two forms:

  • A pink form for the liable driver
  • A green form for the affected driver

However, if none of the parties is to blame, the Dubai Police will hand over a white form.

Essential Things to Do After Reporting an Accident

Notify your insurance company about the accident after you have collected the Dubai Police report. Tell them you have the police report. So that they will advise you on the next steps.

The insurance company will send a recovery truck to tow your vehicle away. However, it depends on the damage to your car. If your insurance company does not offer a recovery service, it might provide you with other recovery options.

FAQS

Can I follow up on my traffic accident report online? If yes, then how?

Absolutely! You can follow up on your request online. Use the transaction number you gave while reporting the accident.

Do I report a minor car accident in Dubai?

There’s a need to report every accident to the Dubai Police. Failure to report will lead to difficulty getting repairs done. Reporting minor car accidents in Dubai has been made much easier. The motorists can use the Dubai Police app to report without calling the police.

Do you have to report an accident if no one was involved?

Yes, drivers must report an accident in Dubai even if they hit an object rather than another car. You must call the Dubai Police so they can issue a damage report, without which you will not be able to get repairs done to your vehicle.

What type of information is needed to report an accident?

The driver’s license number and vehicle ownership number are required to report an accident in Dubai.

Should I have to pay any charges?

The person who caused the accident must pay the filing fee of AED 520. Pay these charges in cash or via e-dirham and debit card.
